Name: Beornhard
Notes: Support/healer, Essence-primary, solid Theurgy plus a genuinely usable Melee attack (Parry 11, Damage 6, no Weapon set - default 1H Heavy Melee) so he's actually fighting most rounds rather than sitting idle in the back - Support=TRUE, so tactics.strategy_support_healer has him spend a limited number of turns healing instead: heal_uses_left starts at floor(hand size / 4) = floor([2 x (Cunning + Mind)] / 4) = floor(6/4) = 1 (rulebook.md's own Cards Per Day/Draw Cycle formula stands in for 'hand size' - see party.py's own comment), spent only once a living ally drops to half Health or below (standing in for Wounded, since this sim has no Shallow/Deep Health split), approximating T105 Healing Magic Lv1 (1 AP, 1 + [Hearts discarded] Shallow Health) - see combat_sim.py's own note on what that showed. Melee bumped from 1 to 2 (Medicine dropped from 2 to 1 to pay for it) specifically to make him a real melee contributor on his non-healing turns, without touching his Theurgy/Composure identity or total XP.
